title: The new test uses node:child_process spawnSync + node:fs for its own setup/asse…
body: The new test uses node:child_process spawnSync + node:fs for its own setup/assertions. Consistent with the rest of the test suite (test-side node fs/proc is conventional here), so not a blocker, but a Bun.spawnSync/Bun.file setup would align the test harness with the very invariant this PR enforces in production.
